nodes.label: Dynamic Product Customization
nodes.rationale: Customers select Material, Color and Shape; each selection can dynamically modify the base price, letting one product record represent many priced variants instead of duplicating products per combination.

nodes.label: Dynamic Image Carousel Filtering
nodes.rationale: Product images must filter dynamically based on selected characteristics (e.g. if Stone is selected, do not show Wood images) so customers only ever see visually accurate representations of their configured product.

nodes.label: Engraving Options (Custom Upload vs Predefined Designs)
nodes.rationale: Customers can either upload their own image/vector for engraving at checkout or pick from an admin-curated gallery of predefined designs scoped to that product.
nodes.norm_label: engraving options (custom upload vs predefined designs)

nodes.label: Custom Localized Checkout Workflow (No Payment Gateway)
nodes.rationale: Instead of a credit-card payment gateway, checkout uses a manual verification workflow (upload of a bank transfer or SINPE Movil receipt) because this is the typical payment practice in Costa Rica, avoiding gateway integration cost/complexity for a startup.
nodes.norm_label: custom localized checkout workflow (no payment gateway)

nodes.label: Admin Panel Order Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Orders move through a fixed sequential state machine (Esperando Pago -> Verificando Pago -> En Progreso -> Enviado -> Entregado) mirroring the manual, human-verified payment and fulfillment process needed since there is no payment gateway.
nodes.norm_label: admin panel order lifecycle state machine

nodes.label: Dynamic Image Mapping (Admin Tags Images to Attribute Combos)
nodes.rationale: Images are uploaded and tagged with specific characteristic combinations (e.g. Material: Wood, Shape: Round) so the frontend carousel can be driven purely by data instead of hardcoded per-variant logic.
nodes.norm_label: dynamic image mapping (admin tags images to attribute combos)

nodes.label: Stock Management
nodes.rationale: Stock is deducted automatically on completed orders but admins can also manually override/update stock levels, balancing automation with real-world inventory correction needs.
